column1: # Theme hook registry (ADR-0020 decision 4): the single owner of where each
# theme key is used. One tab-separated row per hook line:
# key, class (T themed, D dual, - plumbing), file, owner (upstream or
# pixeloven), the hook line exactly as written (leading whitespace ignored), and
# the upstream line it replaces (empty for an added line).
# bin/po-theme.sh reads it for `registry` (gates A4 and A9) and `anchors` (A10).
